decisions.title: default-tier accept target met when the point estimate, per language, is >= 95%
course-material repos stay in; results also shown without them
parseable files = scan files - parse errors; census or init failures reported, no swap
not-wrong target met when the point estimate, per language, is >= 95%
the default tier admits only in-repo structural rules (tier-d5.json), approved before any held-out census
secondary sets measured under the D5 tier: a tier-only amendment applying D5 to the secondary manifests
rubric v3 (RUBRIC-v3.md) for the held-out run and later dev rounds; the default tier ships as advise until it measures >= 95% under v3

target.criterion: met when the point estimate, per language, is ≥ 95% (decision D1, 2026-11-05)

not_wrong_target.criterion: met when the point estimate, per language, is ≥ 95% (decision D4, 2026-11-05)
